d:
Around 700 supermarkets in France were hit by a cyberattack that allegedly tampered with their refrigeration systems, causing food worth millions to spoil. France has directly accused Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) of being behind the attack and has summoned an Iranian diplomat. Investigators have reportedly traced links to an Iran-based cyber unit called Shahid Kaveh. Were supermarkets across Europe targeted too? And why is France threatening action at the European level?
Production: Akash Singh
Video Editor: Shakir Khan
